package context

// Context is not the standard one, so a global taking it is not
// context-first.
type Context interface{ Done() }
-- shared/globals.go --
package shared

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	fake "app/notcontext"
)

type viewer struct{ Name string }

type Helpers struct{}

type helpers struct{}

type notAStruct func()

type argument = string

//fabrik:templates:global
func NoContext(name string) string { return name }

//fabrik:templates:global
func BadResult(ctx context.Context) (string, string) { return "", "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func LookalikeContext(ctx fake.Context) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Generic[T any](ctx context.Context, v T) T { return v }

//fabrik:templates:global
func Variadic(ctx context.Context, parts ...string) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnexportedArg(ctx context.Context, v viewer) string { return v.Name }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnexportedResult(ctx context.Context) viewer { return viewer{} }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnexportedInChannel(ctx context.Context, ch chan viewer) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnexportedInFunc(ctx context.Context, fn func(viewer) error) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnexportedAlias(ctx context.Context, v argument) string { return string(v) }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnnameableStruct(ctx context.Context, v struct{ private int }) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func UnnameableInterface(ctx context.Context, v interface{ private() }) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func (h *Helpers) unexportedMethod(ctx context.Context) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global
func (h *helpers) OnUnexported(ctx context.Context) string { return "" }

type Box[T any] struct{}

//fabrik:templates:func
func (b *Box[T]) OnGenericReceiver(s string) string { return s }

//fabrik:templates:global
func (n notAStruct) OnFunc(ctx context.Context) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:global name=humanizeAge
func Collides(ctx context.Context) string { return "" }

//fabrik:templates:func
func HumanizeAge(t time.Time) string { return t.String() }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"
)

type Handlers struct {
	Templates *templates.Set
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func (h *Handlers) Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.Templates.Render(r.Context(), w, "home", nil)
}
